title: Rescue/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Lotus and Operative transmissions during Rescue missions.
- Lotus: "This is a rescue mission. We need to find and liberate the hostage before any harm comes to them."
- Lotus: "There is a prisoner here that is vital to our operations. Search for the holding location."
- Lotus: "Our intel suggests that our person of interest is in the vicinity. Search for the hostage, and bring them home."
- Lotus: "Find the captive as soon as you can, we don't have much time."
- Lotus: "We can't leave without rescuing the prisoner, keep searching."
- Lotus: "There's no telling what the captors are doing to our rescue target, you need to find the holding cell immediately."
- Lotus: "You are approaching the holding area. Careful, if the wardens detect you, they will surely initiate the execution sequence."
- Lotus: "The enemy is on high alert. The moment you enter the holding area, they'll trigger the execution sequence. Rescue the hostage before it finishes."
- Corpus Crew: "Tenno operatives have entered the cell block. Initiate the execution sequence!"
- Corpus Crew: "The Tenno have breached the holding cell! Discard the hostages!"
- Grineer Grunt: "The Tenno are here, execute the hostage!"
- Grineer Grunt: "Tenno? Begin the execution sequence!"
- Lotus: "Hurry up. You are running out of time."
- Lotus: "The hostage is almost out of time, hurry."
- Lotus: "Here are the holding cells. Search each one for the hostage."
- Lotus: "The captive will be in one of these cells. Search them."
- Lotus: "We've reached the prison. Find our prisoner in one of these cells."
- Lotus: "This is the jail. Our hostage is in one of these cells."
- Male Operative: "(Banging against metal) Hurry up! I am running out of time!"
- Male Operative: "(Banging against metal) In here! I'm in here!"
- Male Operative: "(Banging against metal) Tenno, in here!"
- Female Operative: "(Banging against metal) Hey, is someone out there?"
- Female Operative: "(Banging against metal) I'm in here!"
- Female Operative: "(Banging against metal) Quick! Get the door open!"
- Lotus: "Execution sequence initiated. Get the hostage out of there before it is too late!"
- Lotus: "You've located the hostage. Escort the prisoner to the extraction point and I'll take care of the rest."
- Lotus: "Subject found. You need to bring the captive to safety. Protect them at all costs."
- Lotus: "Prisoner located. We need to get them back to command in one piece, find your way to the exits and don't leave the subject behind."
- Male Operative: "I thought I was going to die in there. Thank you."
- Male Operative: "I am in your debt, Tenno. Let's go home."
- Female Operative: "Thank the stars. Not a minute too soon."
- Female Operative: "I knew you would come. Thank you."
- Female Operative: "I will not forget this, Tenno."
- Male Operative: "I can fight too. Give me a weapon."
- Male Operative: "Give me a weapon and I'll watch your back."
- Male Operative: "Got an extra weapon? They won't just let us walk out of here."
- Female Operative: "I don't suppose you have an extra gun?"
- Female Operative: "Got a weapon for me? I've got some scores to settle."
- Male Operative: "Agh, they got me. Tenno, help!"
- Female Operative: "It hurts. Help, it hurts!"
- Lotus: "Mission complete. The captive has been liberated, you will be rewarded for this Tenno."
- Lotus: "Escort mission complete, the hostage is safe now. Let's get out of here."
- Lotus: "The captive has been secured, you've done your part Tenno, we'll take it from here."
- Lotus: "They killed the hostage. This mission is a failure."
- Lotus: "You let the hostage die. This mission is over."
- Lotus: "While searching vault portals for lost artifacts, a Tenno ally has been trapped by a long forgotten Orokin security mechanism. Rescue this agent."
- Lotus: "One of our allies has been trapped by an ancient Orokin security system. Get them out alive."
- Lotus: "Our scavenger has been snared by a long dormant Orokin security system. It's our duty to see that they make it home safe."
- Lotus: "Vault portals are a link between this place and secure vaults across the System. Orokin security has trapped our agent in one of those vaults."
- Lotus: "The security system is waiting to release our agent to Orokin authorities. Authorities that are long dead."
- Lotus: "There is a vault portal nearby. If security detects you, it will start to process to shut down the portal, severing any link with our agent."
- Lotus: "Quick, use those consoles to change the destination of the vault portal. One of them has to lead to our agent."
- Lotus: "It's our agent! Make sure they get home safely."
- Lotus: "You found our agent! Escort them to extraction."
- Lotus: "You're here to rescue an operative who has been trapped by the Infestation."
- Lotus: "One of our operatives has been trapped by the Infestation. You must rescue them."
- Lotus: "The Infestation has trapped our operative in an emergency airlock. Find and free the captive."
- Lotus: "The Infestation has spread to this location faster than anyone predicted. Everyone is gone, except our operative."
- Lotus: "It is almost as if the Infestation has deliberately captured our operative. This behavior is highly unusual."
- Lotus: "Our operative was able to survive by hiding in an airlock. Unfortunately, they have now become trapped by the Infestation's growths."
- Lotus: "Beware, those lasers are linked to the poison tumor nodes growing on the airlocks. Contact with one of these lasers will put our operative in peril."
- Lotus: "The operative is trapped in one of these airlocks. You must destroy the tumor nodes before you can rescue them."
- Lotus: "Destroy the tumor nodes and open the airlocks. Our operative is in one of them."
- Lotus: "You set off a laser. The Infestation is responding by gassing our operative. Get them out of there immediately!"
- Lotus: "Our operative has succumbed to the gas toxin. This mission is a failure."
- Lotus: "You found the operative, now bring them home."
- Lotus: "You located the operative. Make sure they get to extraction alive."
- Lotus: "The operative is safe. Good work, Tenno."
- Lotus: "You freed the captive, well done."
